mentions.name: Property tax exemption compliance software
mentions.description: Software that manages property tax exemption compliance for a non-profit whose clients are 70+ property managers in North Carolina and South Carolina, including some managing 10,000+ units. It consumes source data exported from Entrata, Yardi, and manually managed Excel spreadsheets, and the author manages its entire development and support via Claude Code.
mentions.source_excerpt: They are a non profit and have a software (that I build) to manage property tax exemption compliance.
